newsitem.title: CANADA: Canada's Prairies to see snow, cool temperatures.
newsitem.headline: Canada's Prairies to see snow, cool temperatures.

text.p: Canada's Prairies Tuesday were forecast to see snow, Environment Canada said.
Manitoba and eastern Saskatchewan saw 1.2 mm of rain in the last 24 hours while southwest Alberta saw four to eight cm of snow, meteorologist Henry Rymarczuk said.
Alberta should see snow and highs of -11 to -15 Celsius.
Saskatchewan should see snow and highs of -4.0 to -16 Celsius.
Manitoba should see rain and wet snow with highs of -3.0 to 9.0 Celsius.
